concrete_scene.actor_or_system: An ambiguous user request, a local-artifact specialist, a public-release specialist, a safe generalist, authority gates, and clarification
concrete_scene.attempted_action: Choose a public-release specialist from semantic similarity without knowing the target or effect.
concrete_scene.observable_outcome: Different candidate authority envelopes expose material ambiguity, so the router abstains and later selects the least-authority route from the clarified target.
concrete_scene.failed_or_tested_boundary: The scene tests whether confidence or capability fit may substitute for authority, readiness, and target identity; it may not.
concrete_scene.residual_owner: Request, router, candidate, readiness, authority, cost-quality, fallback, rejected-candidate, and effect owners retain residuals.
concrete_scene.evidence_boundary: The finite route model checks authored selection fields and does not establish learned routing accuracy, calibration, useful throughput, or specialist quality.

worked_trace.heading: Worked ambiguous route: “remove the old release”
worked_trace.maximum_inference: Authority, readiness, candidate evidence, fallback, and abstention can constrain routing records; actual routing competence and system utility remain unproven.

counterexample_or_simpler_baseline: The confidence-only router selects the familiar deployment specialist. The governed router abstains because local deletion and public withdrawal require different authority.
readable_claim: A router should choose the least capable qualified route that meets the task, and it should abstain when ambiguity makes specialist selection unsafe.
normative_rule: Bind the request, candidate denominator, capability need, authority ceiling, readiness lease, context, cost-quality record, fallback, rejected candidates, and residual owner. Authority mismatch or failed readiness blocks selection; unresolved ambiguity routes to clarification or a safe generalist.

formal_binding.anchor: lightweight routing head that selects bounded specialist cores

caveat_consolidation.local_caveat: The example states once that record-level routing is not learned routing quality.
caveat_consolidation.consolidated_disposition: Requests, candidates, capability, authority, readiness, context, cost, quality, fallback, accuracy, calibration, support, and release remain distinct.

bookkeeping_surface_disposition: The two materially different targets stay reader-facing; complete route schemas remain formal.

editorial_diagnostics.mega_sentence_disposition: The claim and rule give routing a direct least-authority and abstention spine.
editorial_diagnostics.hedge_disposition: The quality boundary follows the ambiguous route once.
editorial_diagnostics.table_disposition: Specialist registries remain because capabilities, costs, and authority differ.

non_claims: The example does not establish learned routing accuracy.
A qualified route record does not establish specialist quality.
